workload: 2000 independent WebSocket clients; destination actions every 500 ms; crowded spawn; native production map; SQLite WAL
notes: Movement records are deltas: idle interests produce no packet, so delivered frames/s and frame gaps are not the configured 10 Hz broadcast cadence.
Snapshot latency is loopback wire latency, not action-to-result or WAN latency.
Tick and broadcast times are last health samples, not percentiles.
This differs from the older continuous-pose workload; compare bandwidth with that limitation.
